## Problem and result

What user action failed or what behavior is needed? Describe the before/after.

## Scope

What changed? Note data/import/shared-component impact and any deliberately deferred work.

## Validation

List commands and observed results, or explain why a check does not apply.
For UI changes, include starting state, action, expected outcome, widths and visual evidence.
Confirm mocked tests made no real Steam requests. Link the latest CI run when available.

## Remaining risks

Record known gaps and follow-up work. Distinguish preview deployment from production readiness.
